about.title: About Us
about.missionText: Mangala Shri Bhuti is a nonprofit organization providing a space for teachings and practice in the Nyingma tradition of Tibetan Buddhism.
about.historyText: Mangala Shri Bhuti was founded by Dzigar Kongtrul Rinpoche to establish and transmit the Longchen Nyingtik tradition. The Japan chapter was established to provide teachings in Japanese and nurture a local practice community.
about.studyText: We value deep study of traditional texts and teachings.
about.practiceText: We emphasize meditation practice in daily life.
about.communityText: We foster a warm community of learning and practice together.
about.serviceText: We aspire to share the teachings widely and contribute to society.

start.title: New Visitors
start.subtitle: Welcome to Mangala Shri Bhuti Japan
start.intro: Whether you are interested in Tibetan Buddhism, wish to begin meditation, or simply curious — everyone is welcome.
start.meditationDesc: We offer step-by-step meditation instruction for beginners through advanced practitioners.
start.studyGroupDesc: Opportunities to study Tibetan Buddhist texts and teachings in Japanese.
start.retreatDesc: Regular retreats for intensive practice away from daily life.
start.step1Desc: Look for beginner-friendly events on our events page.
start.step2Desc: Sign up through the registration form on the event page.
start.step3Desc: If you have questions, please reach out through our contact form.
start.faq1Q: Do I need prior knowledge of Buddhism?
start.faq1A: No prior knowledge is needed. Beginner-friendly events cover the fundamentals.
start.faq2Q: Is there a fee to participate?
start.faq2A: Many events are free or by donation. Some events have a fee — details are on each event page.
start.faq3A: Yes, many events offer online participation. Check the event details for how to join.

gatherings.title: Weekly Gatherings
gatherings.description: Join our regular weekly gatherings for meditation and dharma study.
gatherings.meditationDesc: We begin each gathering with guided meditation practice suitable for all levels.
gatherings.studyDesc: After meditation, we explore Buddhist teachings and discuss their application in daily life.
gatherings.communityDesc: An opportunity to connect with fellow practitioners over tea.
gatherings.noGatherings: Weekly gathering schedules will be posted here soon. Subscribe to our newsletter for updates.

memberPrograms.title: Member Programs
memberPrograms.description: Dedicated study and practice programs for committed members of Mangala Shri Bhuti Japan.
memberPrograms.aboutDesc: Member programs offer deeper engagement with the Nyingma tradition through structured study, advanced meditation instruction, and mentored practice.
memberPrograms.studyDesc: In-depth study of foundational and advanced texts in the Longchen Nyingtik tradition.
memberPrograms.practiceDesc: Structured meditation programs with regular check-ins and guidance from senior practitioners.
memberPrograms.mentorDesc: Personal guidance from experienced practitioners to support your study and practice.
memberPrograms.noPrograms: Member program details will be available soon. Please contact us for more information.

lifeRelease.title: Life Release
lifeRelease.description: The practice of life release (tsethar) is a compassionate activity of freeing animals destined for slaughter.
lifeRelease.whatIsDesc: Life release (tsethar in Tibetan) is a traditional Buddhist practice of saving and releasing animals that would otherwise be killed. It is considered a powerful practice for generating merit and cultivating compassion.
lifeRelease.participateDesc: You can sponsor life release ceremonies through our donation page. Each unit starts from ¥2,000.
lifeRelease.noCeremonies: Upcoming life release ceremonies will be announced here. Subscribe to our newsletter for updates.

prayerRequests.title: Prayer Requests
prayerRequests.description: Submit a prayer request to be included in our regular practice sessions and ceremonies.
prayerRequests.howItWorksDesc: Prayer requests are read aloud and prayed for during our regular practice sessions and special ceremonies. Please include your name and specific wishes.
prayerRequests.submitDesc: You can submit a prayer request through our donation page by selecting the appropriate designation.
prayerRequests.noPrayerRequests: For prayer requests, please visit our donation page and include your request in the prayer request field.
